race.comment: AURA (9) resumed over 1550m at the Kensington track last start and caught the eye in the closing stages, closing nicely for third in a promising return. Beaten just half a length in a Saturday BM74 over 2000m at Caulfield last prep which is excellent form for a race like this. Finds an ideal second-up assignment. TRIPTOLEMUS (5) has led all the way to win three in a row in southern NSW, the latest in comfortable style in a BM82 over the Corowa mile. Goes extra well for Keatings who keeps the ride. Should cope in this company and will run another bold race. SAVVY SPY (10) is fitter for two runs back. Will make his own luck up front and looks a strong lightweight hope. THINK ITZ YOU (4) bolted in at Newcastle last time out and is good enough to go to this next level. HALLOWED HALLS (6) looked in need of the run at Warwick Farm last Wednesday and can improve sharply.
